text_block_list.text:
I flinch instinctively at Agnes Tachyon, 
who is unusually focused compared to ever 
before.
choice_data_list: Rare to see you taking this so seriously.
Rare to see you taking this so seriously.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, today is what you might call a 
verification experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today's data will serve as a benchmark for 
the future. In other words, preparation 
must be thorough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—No, wait, did you just say 'for once'? 
I'm always reasonably serious!"

Regardless of the truth behind those 
words— Agnes Tachyon was undeniably giving 
off a completely different atmosphere 
today compared to her usual pre-race 
demeanor.
